اغترفتن (form VIII)
# اِغْتَرَفْتُنَّ (iḡtaraftunna) /iɣ.ta.raf.tun.na/: second-person feminine plural past active of اِغْتَرَفَ (iḡtarafa)
# اُغْتُرِفْتُنَّ (uḡturiftunna) /uɣ.tu.rif.tun.na/: second-person feminine plural past passive of اِغْتَرَفَ (iḡtarafa)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
